Behavioral Competency Requirements

Commercial Tenacity

Drive for Results: Works with a sense of urgency to drive tasks through to completion. Pushes self and teammates to meet challenging goals. Sets high standards of excellence for self and teammates. Maintains a clear focus on what needs to be done to achieve end goals for self and team.

Business Sense: Recognizes market trends. Understands the value of organizational and market metrics for carrying through team strategy. Prioritizes activities that will likely deliver the best return on investment. Demonstrates an awareness of the challenges the organization faces and the objectives it is trying to achieve.

Resilience: Focuses on long-term goals instead of short-term challenges. Adapts to adverse or challenging situations without lasting negative impact. Acknowledges obstacles and perseveres until difficulties are overcome. Receives criticism and failure as useful feedback to enable future success.

Building Trust

Building Relationships: Seeks opportunities to connect with others. Interacts with others in a friendly and polite way. Identifies shared interests and/or commonalities to build or deepen relationships. Maintains a strong network of contacts through regular outreach and communication.

Teamwork: Actively collaborates with others to build cohesion and better achieve goals. Offers to help others with their work, even when lacking a direct personal interest. Respects others’ talents, contributions, and perspectives. Openly shares relevant knowledge, expertise, and information.

Customer Focus: Takes care to listen to prospects’/customers’ needs and concerns to ensure they feel understood. Identifies solutions that meet the unique needs and priorities of each prospect/customer. Provides prompt, respectful, and attentive service. Strives to exceed customer expectations.

Consultative Skills

Problem Solving: Addresses root causes, not just symptoms. Identifies and considers context, constraints, and risks. Establishes a clear course of action when problems arise. Considers and explores what alternative solutions are available.

Communication: Conveys ideas and information clearly and concisely. Tailors the method and content to the audience, message, and context. Checks to ensure messages have been understood. Actively listens and asks questions to verify own understanding.

Influencing: Presents ideas in a confident, convincing, and credible way. Appeals to the goals or interests of others by leveraging logic, emotion, or connection. Listens to and addresses objections and concerns. Asks others for input to gather information, understand needs, and enhance the solution and/or its presentation.

Negotiating: Clarifies goals and balances the objectives of both parties to achieve constructive outcomes. Remains open to creative and alternative possibilities and solutions. Uses both direct and diplomatic communication in negotiations.

Job Mode: Full-time

Job Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled and proactive Senior React Native Developer with strong experience in native iOS app development. description:
Overview

We are seeking a full-time, remote Senior Full Stack Software Engineer with 5+ years of software development experience and a strong background in JavaScript frameworks and libraries, including Node.js, to join our U.S. client's engineering team. Working closely with product stakeholders, you will play a vital role in developing an industry-leading product. The client is focused on AI-first development, so a significant part of your role will involve designing and implementing AI-driven features using AI-first development techniques. This includes leveraging prompt engineering to optimize the client's AI models and utilizing cutting-edge tools, such as Cursor and Copilot, to enable more innovative development. As a Senior Full Stack Software Engineer, your role is to collaborate with product teams to create, publish, and develop high-quality software that facilitates veterinarian-patient communication and reduces the burden on clinic staff. You should see the big picture of where the client is going and fill in the gaps, actively integrating AI tools and techniques into daily engineering workflow, supporting thoughtful discussions, and challenging existing ideas.

Our client is on a mission to provide technology and services that enable veterinary practices to provide the highest quality of care to pet owners. The company is a well-funded, growth-stage company comprising individuals who thrive in a fast-paced, passionate, and entrepreneurial environment. Our client has thousands (and counting) of veterinarians within its customer base today.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, design, and ship new applications and features
  • Build and enhance advanced applications utilizing your JavaScript stack skills
  • Design and implement AI-first features using LLMs (e.g., OpenAI, Claude)
  • Integrate and leverage AI development tools like Cursor and Copilot
  • Provide estimates for features, bug fixes, upgrades, and new projects
  • Participate in clearly and concisely documenting applications and custom-built frameworks
  • Write automated unit and feature tests enabling continuous delivery of your great work
  • Continuously discover, evaluate, and implement new technologies (especially AI-related) to maximize development efficiency
  • Support other teammates through good communication and feedback during code reviews
  • See the big picture and support the client\'s mission of facilitating better pet care

Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication and interpersonal skills
  • 5+ years of full stack engineering experience working on consumer-facing (B2C or B2B), high-volume, commercial software products and services
  • 3+ years of JavaScript framework / library or Node.js, Express, and TypeScript (bonus) experience
  • Proven expertise in prompt engineering for various AI models
  • Regular use of AI tools like Copilot, Cursor, or others to streamline development is preferred
  • A curiosity to explore how you can improve your workflow using AI

  • Knowledge of both relational and non-relational database systems (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL, DynamoDB)
  • High execution mindset while balancing the risk vs costs vs timeline
  • Proven history of delivering production-ready applications promptly
  • Experience creating and consuming API\'s (preferably with GraphQL)
  • Familiarity with AWS cloud services (server setup a bonus)
  • Team player eager to learn from and mentor others
  • Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • A collaborative approach, a can-do attitude, and a relentless pursuit to attain goals and solve problems
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent

Preferred Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience (optimally a technical or engineering degree)
  • Strong experience with AI-first development methodologies

Additional Information

  • Know that your ideas are heard and matter — think big!
  • Own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart, creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let’s learn from them and be transparent!
  • Be recognized as an individual — no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days PTO, one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start : ASAP

title: Gerente De Vendas | Energia Solar
description:
Você conhece a Sany do Brasil?

Fundada em 1989 em Changsha, na China, o Grupo Sany dedica-se à produção de máquinas pesadas, tendo como principais produtos as máquinas para construção civil, pavimentação, escavação, reach stacker, guindastes, máquinas portuárias e de mineração. A empresa atua com dez fábricas na China, uma na Índia, uma na Alemanha e uma nos Estados Unidos, além de aplicar políticas de investimento em pesquisa e desenvolvimento de novas tecnologias.

Como parte da sua estratégia de crescimento, em 2012, a Sany adquiriu a empresa alemã Putzmeister, formando o maior líder mundial na área de equipamentos para concreto. Hoje, a Sany emprega cerca de 40 mil colaboradores em mais de 150 países.

No Brasil, a trajetória do Grupo Sany iniciou em 2007, atuando como importador de equipamentos. Em 2011, consolidou-se no país com investimentos de aproximadamente US$ 200 milhões. Em janeiro do mesmo ano, a Sany inaugurou em São José dos Campos, SP, sua primeira unidade fabril para montagem de escavadeiras e guindastes sobre caminhão no regime CKD (Completely Knock-Down), em uma área total de 30 mil m².

Em 2012, a Sany recebeu a certificação ISO 9001:2008, assegurando o rigoroso processo de qualidade e segurança da empresa. Em 2013, iniciou a montagem de guindastes RT (rough terrain) e de rolos compactadores em sua unidade fabril. No final de 2017, foram inauguradas as novas instalações em Jacareí, SP. A Sany mantém uma rede de distribuidores e filiais próprias para oferecer seus produtos e serviços de pós-venda em todas as regiões do país.

Como nosso Gerente de Vendas

Como nosso Gerente de Vendas, você irá :

  • Gerenciar soluções de redes inteligentes (smart grid) ao longo de todo o seu ciclo de vida, garantindo que os requisitos dos produtos estejam alinhados às necessidades do mercado e aos objetivos da empresa;
  • Definir as ofertas de produtos, incluindo hardware, software, operações, serviços e modelos de negócios, coordenando atividades entre diversos departamentos;
  • Desenvolver e executar estratégias de entrada no mercado (go-to-market) e planos de lançamento de produtos;
  • Monitorar o desenvolvimento, entrega e status dos serviços das soluções, assegurando o cumprimento dos prazos de lançamento, qualidade e alinhamento com o mercado;
  • Liderar a definição de ofertas comerciais para os mercados-alvo, incluindo estratégias de precificação, e acompanhar a rentabilidade dos produtos e serviços;
  • Analisar métricas de desempenho dos produtos para promover melhorias contínuas e garantir o sucesso das soluções.

Requisitos para que possa se juntar ao nós :

  • Graduação ou Pós-graduação, preferencialmente em Engenharia Elétrica;
  • Experiência comprovada em áreas tecnológicas como sistemas de energia, redes elétricas inteligentes (smart grids);
  • Inglês fluente, tanto na forma escrita quanto falada.

Você usufruirá dos seguintes benefícios :

  • Assistência Médica
  • Assistência Odontológica
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Vale Refeição
  • Transporte
  • Crédito Consignado
  • Ticket Mês Aniversário

title: Senior Devops Engineer
description:
Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary

As a Senior DevOps Engineer, you will actively interface with software developers, product managers, test engineers, and administrators on projects to design and develop the build, release, and deploy toolchain for DevOps while providing on-call support. You should be able to identify, troubleshoot and resolve issues quickly and effectively, sometimes under pressure. Responsibilities include capacity planning, high availability engineering, performance tuning, and automation / tools development. You should have good leadership skills, experience managing infrastructure through multiple product releases, and have a passion for reliability and security.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Lead the design and management of highly available, scalable Kubernetes infrastructure using Amazon EKS;
  • Implement and manage infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) with Terraform and Terragrunt;
  • Champion a Git-first approach to infrastructure and CI / CD automation;
  • Build and maintain robust CI / CD pipelines using Harness to streamline application delivery across environments;
  • Drive infrastructure automation and environment consistency across development, staging, and production;
  • Design and implement monitoring and observability solutions using New Relic, ensuring performance visibility and uptime;
  • Securely manage secrets using AWS Secrets Manager;
  • Support production systems through incident management, root cause analysis, and proactive reliability improvements;
  • Collaborate with engineering and security teams to define best practices for deployment, security, and scalability;
  • Mentor and guide junior DevOps team members and developers in adopting modern infrastructure practices.

Essential Skills

  • Experience with DevOps, SRE, or Platform Engineering role supporting cloud-native applications;
  • Extensive experience with Kubernetes (EKS), including Helm, networking, and security;
  • Deep proficiency in Terraform and Terragrunt for AWS infrastructure provisioning;
  • Proven expertise building pipelines with Harness, Git, and associated CI / CD tooling;
  • Strong scripting and automation skills using Python or Golang;
  • Solid understanding of AWS services : EKS, EC2, S3, IAM, RDS, VPC, Route53, CloudWatch, etc;
  • Proficient with Linux systems, including performance tuning and troubleshooting;
  • Deep knowledge of networking fundamentals : DNS, TLS, HTTP / S, Load Balancing;
  • Experience with Ansible for configuration and provisioning;
  • Working knowledge of MySQL and PostgreSQL;
  • Strong experience in monitoring, logging, and alerting, particularly using New Relic;
  • Experience with Kafka, RabbitMQ, or other pub / sub systems is a plus;
  • Demonstrated ability to support and troubleshoot distributed products.

title: Programme Analyst
description:
Result of Service

The Programme Analyst reports to the Head of Brazil Office. He/She shall duly and timely perform his/her obligations, under this Term of Reference. The consultant will work in close collaboration with UN-Habitat’s operational and technical teams.

Work Location
Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Expected duration
Six (6) months, with possibility of renewal

Responsibilities

  1. Supervise fieldwork and the active search process (ensure Safer Access protocols are followed, monitor the delivery of questionnaires daily) in loco and online.
  2. Ensure information about the Programme\'s active search process and overall activities are disseminated upon entering new territories.
  3. Provide logistical, organizational and personnel support to events organized by the municipality and other public agencies in designated communities and settlements.
  4. Participate in meetings with municipal public agencies and departments and ensure all measures needed to optimize fieldwork are put into place.
  5. Participate in the Programme\'s Management Committee meetings and liaise with municipal, state and federal agencies to ensure programme implementation.
  6. Supervise the distribution of printed and digital Programme\'s integrated protocols to municipal departments.
  7. Follow the Programme\'s guidelines for organizing and maintaining accessible information files.
  8. Ensure that the Programme\'s technical activities align with the Agency\'s quality expectations.
  9. Participate in the training and induction of new fieldwork staff; document fieldwork staff\'s demands and requests and support coordination for equipment and PPE.
  10. Prepare internal reports of fieldwork activities as requested by the Programme\'s Coordinator.
  11. Perform other duties as requested by the Programme\'s Coordinator.

The consultant will be responsible for completing all courses and training activities indicated by the supervisor. The security course BSAFE, from UNDSS, is required to be accredited during the first month of employment. The consultant will be responsible for his/her own security and should comply with United Nations security mechanisms.

Outputs/Work Assignment

The Programme Analyst will support the implementation of the Programme’s work plan and daily activities, especially in the field, with Local Managers and Field Agents. The consultant shall be paid a monthly allowance upon presentation and approval by the Head of Brazil Office of monthly activities’ report.

Qualifications / Skills

Education Required:

  • Bachelor\'s degree in Social Work, Social Sciences, Geography, Urban Studies, or related fields is required, or an additional three (3) years of relevant experience beyond the requirement.
  • Minimum five (5) years of experience in the above-mentioned fields of work is required.
  • Experience in project management, preferably in public policies and in vulnerable communities in Rio de Janeiro, is required.
  • Experience in the social area and in coordinating fieldwork, preferably in the public sector and in vulnerable areas, is required.
  • Previous experience working in the United Nations is desirable.

Skills / Competencies

  • An organized person, with a leadership profile and ability to articulate teams is required.
  • Professionalism: experience in inter-institutional environments, project management, monitoring-evaluation; governance and development approaches.
  • Planning and organization: strong sense of responsibility, ability to work with minimal supervision and manage deadlines.
  • Communication: clear writing, active listening, ability to tailor messages; strong written communication for diverse audiences.
  • Teamwork: ability to work in multicultural settings, leadership, conflict management and consensus facilitation; sensitivity to vulnerability considerations.
  • Knowledge Management: familiarity with UN-Habitat processes, file management, databases, and sharing of relevant information with the team; ensure content privacy.

Languages

  • Portuguese (fluent required). Working knowledge of English and Spanish desirable.

Additional Information

  • Travel details: The consultant must be available to travel as requested. Travel is coordinated and financed by UN-Habitat according to UN rules.
  • Remuneration: SB-3/4 – BRL 7,268.63 net amount (UNDP Brazil Salary Scale).
  • Notes: Appointment is local; only Brazilian nationals or holders of permanent visas in Brazil may apply. Contract extension depends on funds and performance. Applications must be submitted in English through Inspira with required documents; UN-Habitat does not charge any recruitment fee.

Descrição da Vaga

OPORTUNIDADE DE PARCERIA (PJ) Em Desenvolvedor Java Pleno/Sênior

Formada e liderada por professores do Departamento de Engenharia de Produção da Escola Politécnica da Universidade de São Paulo (Poli-USP), a Fundação Vanzolini é uma organização sem fins lucrativos, que traduz o conhecimento acadêmico em ações de impacto. Sua estreita ligação com uma das mais prestigiadas universidades da América Latina molda a história da Vanzolini e fortalece seu compromisso com a excelência, evidenciando o rigor acadêmico e a inovação que sustentam sua atuação. Há quase 60 anos, a Fundação desenvolve, aplica e dissemina novos conhecimentos da Engenharia no cotidiano de pessoas, empresas, organizações e governos, contribuindo na resolução de problemas econômicos, ambientais, técnicos e sociais no Brasil e no exterior. Fundamentada em um olhar sistêmico, integrador e multidisciplinar da Engenharia de Produção. A GTE é uma das grandes frentes de atuação da FCAV, desenvolvendo projetos aplicados em operações, sistemas de gestão, inovação e políticas públicas, atuando, principalmente, em iniciativas tecnológicas. Nesse segmento, a Fundação Vanzolini tem forte atuação – em parceria com entidades governamentais – no desenvolvimento de projetos relacionados às necessidades do setor público, principalmente nas áreas da Saúde e Educação.

Descrição da Vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Java Pleno/Sênior para integrar nosso time de desenvolvimento. O profissional será responsável por analisar, desenvolver, testar e manter aplicações web e serviços de backend, participando de todo o ciclo de vida do software, desde a concepção até a entrega em produção, atuando em soluções de alta complexidade e escalabilidade.

A posição é totalmente remota, permitindo que você trabalhe de qualquer local do Brasil.

Requisitos Técnicos Obrigatórios

  • Backend
    • Java 11+ (Java 17 desejável).
    • Spring Framework / Spring Boot.
    • JPA / Hibernate.
    • Criação e consumo de APIs REST.
    • Maven ou Gradle.
  • Frontend (desejável
    • HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (ES6+).
    • Frameworks modernos (Angular ou React).
    • Bootstrap.
  • Banco de Dados
    • Experiência com bancos relacionais (MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle).
    • Conhecimento em NoSQL (MongoDB, Redis) será diferencial.
  • Outros
    • Git/GitLab/GitHub.
    • Testes unitários e automatizados (JUnit, Mockito).
    • Conceitos de arquitetura de software (REST, Microservices).
    • Experiência com CI/CD (Jenkins, GitLab CI).
    • Segurança de aplicações (OAuth2, JWT, OWASP).
    • Metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban).

Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver e manter aplicações web full stack utilizando Java e frameworks modernos.
  • Projetar e implementar APIs RESTful, microsserviços e integrações com serviços externos.
  • Atuar na análise de requisitos, modelagem de sistemas e definição de arquitetura.
  • Desenvolver interfaces responsivas e amigáveis para o usuário (quando necessário).
  • Garantir boas práticas de programação, versionamento e qualidade de código (Clean Code, SOLID).
  • Liderar revisões de código e apoiar desenvolvedores mais juniores.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com as equipes de QA, infraestrutura e produto para entregar soluções robustas e de alta performance.
  • Identificar e propor melhorias de performance e segurança.

Perfil Esperado

  • Proatividade e capacidade de aprendizado contínuo.
  • Boa comunicação e trabalho em equipe.
  • Visão crítica e foco em soluções escaláveis.
  • Autonomia para decisões técnicas e mentoria de colegas.

Graduação completa em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.

description:
Job description

Faça parte de uma das principais companhias independentes de Óleo & Gás.

Atuamos nos segmentos onshore, offshore e downstream, oferecendo amplas oportunidades para o desenvolvimento da sua carreira. Somos dinâmicos, focados em resultados e comprometidos com o crescimento contínuo. Nossas pessoas são a essência do nosso sucesso, por isso valorizamos a meritocracia, a autonomia e uma cultura de aprendizado constante.

Venha crescer com a gente!

Missão do cargo:

Estabelecer políticas, estratégias e diretrizes da disciplina de Engenharia de Confiabilidade de Manutenção das instalações e equipamentos por meio da implementação de metodologias de Engenharia de Confiabilidade e dos planos de manutenção preventiva e preditiva a fim de garantir e maximizar a confiabilidade, disponibilidade, manutenção, segurança e integridade dos ativos no ciclo de vida útil, dando atendimento aos objetivos de custos, produtividade, qualidade e segurança, assim como a preservação do meio ambiente de acordo com as políticas da COMPANHIA e conformidade legal aplicável.

Main responsibilities

  1. Dar suporte técnico nas diferentes etapas dos Projetos (Engenharia Conceitual, Básica e Detalhada) para garantir a confiabilidade e disponibilidade das instalações, equipamentos e sistemas inerentes ao Projeto, aplicando metodologias e estudos de Engenharia de Confiabilidade;
  2. Estabelecer as políticas, estratégiase programas de Engenharia de Confiabilidade para otimizar os planos de manutenção preventiva e preditiva, garantindo a confiabilidade de equipamentos e instalações através de uma relação custo-risco-beneficio positiva na gestão de ativos;
  3. Desenvolver e implementar metodologias de análise para determinar a confiabilidade e disponibilidade das instalações, componentes, equipamentos e sistemas;
  4. Realizar análise de problemas operacionais para minimizarfalhas ou paradas não programadas que tem impacto na continuidade operacional, segurança e confiabilidade para atingir os objetivos estabelecidos, alémde suportar a implementação de técnicas de manutenção preditiva, padrões de gestão, análise de falhas, melhorias de projetos e melhores práticas de planejamento e controle de manutenção. Cumprindo com os objetivos de custos, produtividade, qualidade e segurança, assim como a preservação do meio ambiente de acordo com as políticas da Companhia e conformidade legal aplicável;
  5. Suportar tecnicamente na implementação das metodologias de:Análise de Criticidade de Ativos, Confiabilidade, Análise de Disponibilidade e Manutenibilidade, Metodologia para Desenho de Planos de Inspeção Baseados em Riscos, Metodologia para Solução de Problemas Baseada em Análise de Causa Raiz, Estudos de Custo Risco - Benefício, Análise Econômica do Ciclo de Vida dos Ativos, Manutenção Centrada em Confiabilidade, Análises de efeito e modos de falhas, para otimizar as estratégias e planos de inspeção e manutenção;
  6. Elaborar recomendações técnicas ou planos de ação a fim de atender as necessidades da Operação por meio do alinhamento com a gestão técnica e suporte de manutenção;
  7. Realizar avaliações técnicas dos processos de planejamento, programação, inspeção e manutenção por meio de auditorias técnicas para garantir o cumprimento dos planos estabelecido, objetivos da Companhia e obrigações legais aplicáveis. Suportar o planejamento orçamentário anual (despesas e investimentos) para a disciplina sob responsabilidade, fornecendo informações baseadas em experiências anteriores, conhecimento técnico e melhores práticas do mercado;
  8. Participar e / ou elaborar padrões corporativos como parte do Sistema de Gestão Integrado, bemgeração dos relatórios e notas técnicas inerente ao cargo para preservar o conhecimento dentro da Organização contribuindo com os objetivos de qualidade, custo e produção de óleo e gás. Assegurar que as estratégias de manutenção sejam implementadas nas rotinas da frota em conformidade com as diretrizes da Companhia e órgãos reguladores;
  9. Contribuir para a governança do CMMS atualizando e monitorando informações sobre hierarquia, descrição de trabalho, plano de inspeção e manutenção. Monitorar os KPIs das barreiras de segurança de processos e fornecer recomendação técnica, quando necessário, a fim de garantir a eficácia dos processos e manter a operação da instalação dentro do nível ALARP;
  10. Garantir a comunicação e o alinhamento com a equipe nas Operações e apoiar suas necessidades, a fim de alcançar conformidade com os planos de inspeção e manutenção.

Requirements and skills

  • Formação acadêmica: Engenharia Mecânica, Metalúrgica, de Materiais, Petróleo, Industrial ou áreas correlatas, com mínimo de 7 anos de experiência na especialidade .
  • Experiência em Engenharia de Confiabilidade , incluindo:
  • Análises de causa-raiz;
  • Análise de modos e efeitos de falhas (FMEA/FMECA);
  • Análise de criticidade de ativos;
  • Manutenção centrada em confiabilidade (RCM);
  • Estudos de custo-risco-benefício;
  • Análise de disponibilidade e manutenibilidade;
  • Análise econômica do ciclo de vida dos ativos;
  • Elaboração de planos de inspeção baseados em risco.
  • Conhecimento e aplicação de normas e regulamentações : ASME, ANSI, ISO, OSHAS 18000, Normas Técnicas Brasileiras e demais legislações aplicáveis.
  • Inglês avançado – capacidade de se comunicar verbalmente e por escrito em reuniões de negócios, debates técnicos, elaboração e apresentação de relatórios e seminários.
  • Domínio de ferramentas e softwares de análise estatística de dados para confiabilidade e manutenção.

title: Senior Application Security Engineer
description:
Overview

Rain is the fastest-growing earned wage access (EWA) fintech in the U.S., serving 3.5 million employees and backed by top investors like QED and Prosus. We’ve raised nearly $400M in funding—including the largest Series A in fintech history—and just closed our Series B to fuel our next stage of hypergrowth.

We are seeking a skilled and driven Senior Application Security Engineer to join Rain’s growing Security team. This role demands a proactive approach to secure software development and cloud-native defense. You will partner closely with engineering and development squads, and work alongside our Cloud Security and GRC team members to improve Rain’s application and platform security posture. This position is technically grounded, requiring direct engagement in application-layer matters and security reviews, while also contributing to cloud security automation, awareness initiatives, and secure engineering practices across the SDLC.

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with development squads to validate vulnerabilities and provide actionable remediation guidance aligned with business risk.
  • Drive threat modeling sessions (e.g., STRIDE, PASTA) for critical systems and APIs.
  • Design, implement, and oversee automated processes for securely updating application and code dependencies, proactively mitigating issues and ensuring timely vulnerability remediation.
  • Integrate security checks into CI / CD pipelines (SAST, DAST, SCA, IaC), working with tools like Semgrep, Snyk, Trivy, and Burp Suite.
  • Contribute to runtime security initiatives, such as container / Kubernetes hardening, RASP, and eBPF-based detection.
  • Build and maintain a security issues dashboard to track remediation status and metrics.
  • Provide real-time support in the event of cybersecurity incidents impacting applications or cloud infrastructure (exploited vuln, credential stuffing, web / API attacks).
  • Partner with the Cloud Security team on security automation tasks and monitoring improvements (e.g., Security Hub remediation automations, DLP monitoring, etc.).
  • Conduct proactive research on new threats, vulnerabilities, and attack techniques relevant to Rain’s architecture.
  • Collaborate with the GRC team to develop and deliver internal security awareness initiatives, phishing campaigns, and developer training (e.g., secure coding, API security).
  • Participate in the continuous improvement of AppSec maturity (e.g., aligning with OWASP SAMM, ISO 27001, or SOC 2 frameworks).

Required Qualifications

  • Fluent English, including strong verbal and written skills.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical mindset.
  • Excellent communication skills to convey security risks to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • 3–5+ years of experience in application security, penetration testing roles, and/or secure code development, including work with QA teams.

Estamos em busca de um profissional para atuar como TÉCNICO DE SEGURANÇA DO TRABALHO que seja organizado, prestativo e que tenha uma comunicação assertiva em seus processos de trabalho.

Suas principais atividades

  • Aplicar os conhecimentos técnicos de Segurança do Trabalho de modo a reduzir, neutralizar ou eliminar os riscos à segurança do trabalhador;
  • Orientar o sistema de segurança do trabalho, investigating riscos e causas de acidentes, fazendo as necessárias recomendações para evitar acidentes semelhantes, analisando esquemas de prevenção, observando dispositivos legais e institucionais que objetivem a eliminação, controle ou redução permanente dos riscos de acidentes do trabalho e a melhoria das condições do ambiente, para preservar a integridade física e mental dos trabalhadores;

  • Elaborar e implementar política de saúde, segurança do trabalho e meio ambiente (SSMA);
  • Exigir o cumprimento das condições básicas de Segurança do Trabalho para empresas prestadoras de serviço e contratadas para execução de serviços nas dependências do estabelecimento hospitalar;
  • Acompanhar de forma permanente as atividades realizadas pela CIPA, estudando suas observações e propostas, visando a adoção das soluções corretivas e preventivas de acidentes do trabalho e meio ambiente, valendo-se como agente multiplicador;
  • Controlar, distribuir e inspecionar os equipamentos de proteção individual (EPI);
  • Elaborar documentos de segurança do trabalho como Programa de Prevenção de Riscos Ambientais, dentre outros;
  • Fazer inspeção em equipamentos de proteção contra incêndio, recursos audiovisuais e didáticos e outros materiais considerados indispensáveis, de acordo com a legislação vigente;
  • Propor normas e dispositivos de segurança, sugerindo eventuais modificações nos equipamentos e instalações e verificando sua observância, para prevenir acidentes;
  • Inspecionar os postos de combate a incêndios, examinando as mangueiras, hidrantes, extintores e equipamentos de proteção contra incêndios;
  • Comunicar os resultados de suas inspeções à coordenação do SESMT, elaborando relatórios;
  • Investigar acidentes ocorridos, examinando as condições da ocorrência, para identificar suas causas e propor as providências cabíveis;
  • Intermediar junto aos serviços médico e social da instituição, visando facilitar o atendimento necessário aos acidentados;
  • Registrar irregularidades e elaborar estatísticas de acidentes;
  • Promover campanhas, cursos, palestras e outras formas de treinamento com o objetivo de divulgar as normas de segurança e higiene do trabalho, bem como informar e conscientizar os trabalhadores sobre atividades insalubres, perigosas e penosas;
  • Dar suporte às perícias judiciais, à Medicina do trabalho conforme a deliberação da Coordenação do SESMT.
  • Acompanhar as atividades pela enfermagem, hotelaria, serviços de higiene e limpeza, nutrição, com objetivo de assegurar as normas legais internas em segurança do trabalho;
  • Participar de reuniões sobre segurança no trabalho, fornecendo dados relativos ao assunto, apresentando sugestões e analisando a viabilidade de medidas de segurança propostas, para aperfeiçoar o sistema existente;
  • Executar tarefas pertinentes à área de atuação, utilizando-se de equipamentos e programas de informática;
  • Executar e apoiar outras tarefas para o desenvolvimento das atividades do Setor, inerentes à sua Função;
  • Trabalhar em conformidade com as normas e procedimentos técnicos e de qualidade, segurança, meio ambiente, higiene e saúde.

description:
Overview

Sweden needs skilled engineers!

About 30 000 of them by 2030 to be precise, according to the Swedish Statistical Central Bureau. Right now we have ~200 open positions for Software Engineers with our clients in Sweden. Are you ready to help us?

Job Description

As a senior headhunter you will help us to find engineers who are ready to embark on an adventure to Sweden. Living standards in Sweden are great by any international comparisons, and we need a lot of engineers. Your job will be to find them and inform them about all the benefits of living and working in Sweden. To move to another country is often one of the biggest leaps in life, so a lot of your job will be to build trust with suitable candidates. Supporting you in these tasks, you will have the assistance of a competent global team of recruiters, as well as an executive management team in Sweden. In addition you will be supported by our Swedish delivery management team that handles all practical matters related to the relocation to Sweden for our consultants. In short we fix everything for our employees - visa, work permits, tickets, arrangement of housing, you name it - we fix it!

Our clients are primarily within the fields of software development, R&D, cyber security, automotive, embedded systems, telecommunications, online solutions and application development. Your work will be planned and executed together with your colleagues in Albania, Argentina, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Brazil, Colombia, Hungary, Kenya, North Macedonia, Sweden, Turkey, Ukraine, Venezuela and Vietnam. You will be part of an efficient team characterized by a profound joy for having the opportunity to be able to help engineers and their families to build a new career and life in Sweden. Telescope's core values are joy, trust, and professionalism!

Required competence

  • At least 5 years of professional experience from recruitment in the IT sector, or similar technical experience.
  • A solid and well proven network of local engineering talent within IT.
  • Extremely service oriented, with a flexible mindset towards always finding the best solution for the challenge at hand.
  • High quality and brand awareness.
  • Understanding or interest in headhunting and the principle of IT outstaffing/outsourcing companies.
  • Upper intermediate English.
  • Some knowledge of at least a handful of contemporary IT technologies and methods, as well as the ability to learn the main ideas of new technologies.
  • Analytical, well organized with an eye for details, with the ability to identify and close a recruitment request.
  • Self confident, happy, social, friendly and outgoing with a high level of self motivation.
  • Durable and stubborn, with the capacity to take a 'no' as a reason to try harder.
  • Passionate about success, with an executive yet relaxed attitude towards work, colleagues and customers.
  • Responsive and responsible, with an appropriate and representative appearance.

Extent & Duration

Start ASAP. Full time. Long term contract as a Private Entrepreneur. Minimum 12 months. Eight hours of efficient work per day, Monday to Friday. Overtime compensation 1:1 in flex.

Location

You will be working from home or from a co-location center of your choice.

Economy

Remuneration starting at 1200 USD, plus remittance fees and taxes. Free national holidays, with maintained payment. 20 paid vacation days. Paid travels, housing, and per diem.

Application

title: Network Manager
description:
Overview

Who We Are

Ready to create a healthier world? We are ready for you! Personify Health is on a mission to simplify and personalize the health experience to improve health and reduce costs for companies and their people. At Personify Health, we believe in offering total rewards, flexible opportunities, and a diverse inclusive community, where every voice matters. Together, we’re shaping a healthier, more engaged future.

Responsibilities

Ready to Drive Excellence Across Diverse Network Partnerships?

We're seeking a strategic operational leader who can manage the ongoing performance of our diverse portfolio of leased carrier networks while serving as a direct extension of the Director of Network Management. As our Network Manager, you'll ensure internal operational excellence while supporting the strategic success of our network products, including leased networks and COE partners.

What makes this role different

  • Portfolio management: Oversee diverse network partnerships including secondary, regional, and dental networks with comprehensive performance monitoring
  • Strategic insights: Develop performance dashboards that deliver actionable insights driving business decisions for leadership and client account teams
  • Cross-functional impact: Collaborate with Claims Operations, Clinical teams, and Commercial teams to ensure operational alignment and excellence
  • Implementation leadership: Support GTM new network implementation with project management expertise and operational readiness coordination

What You'll Actually Do

  • Drive network performance excellence: Report on network performance focusing on KPIs including performance guarantees, client and membership growth, network revenue, product utilization, and quality outcomes.
  • Maintain operational oversight: Develop network management documentation, prepare internal updates, manage contracts, and serve as primary contact for operational issues and processes.
  • Monitor compliance rigorously: Track performance guarantees for all networks, ensure accurate delivery of network scorecards, and review data for ongoing compliance with membership growth targets and claims timeliness.
  • Resolve complex escalations: Lead research and resolution of service requests including complex client escalations related to network issues while collaborating with networks on training coordination.
  • Support strategic initiatives: Provide GTM new network implementation support, organize network notifications processes, and contribute to strategic development of network management capabilities.
  • Enable internal teams: Support Claims Operations by providing clarity on unique operational and contractual nuances of each network while building collaborative relationships with Commercial and Operations Enablement teams.

Qualifications

What You Bring to Our Mission

  • The operational foundation:
    • Bachelor's degree in Healthcare Administration, Business, or related field (equivalent work experience considered)
    • 2-4 years experience in provider network management, provider relations, or healthcare operations
    • Experience within TPA, health plan, or health system environment
  • The analytical expertise:
    • Demonstrated experience with different provider reimbursement models including fee-for-service
    • Understanding of value-based care concepts (ACOs, Clinically Integrated Networks)
    • Proven ability to analyze healthcare data (claims, provider, network, eligibility) to identify trends and solve problems
  • The professional competencies:
    • Relationship building: Natural ability to build rapport and establish trust with clients, providers, and internal colleagues
    • Analytical mindset: Strong problem-solving skills with talent for translating complex data into clear, actionable insights
    • Project management: Outstanding organizational skills with ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities effectively
    • Communication excellence: Exceptional written and verbal skills for presenting information clearly to diverse audiences
    • Autonomy and initiative: Self-starter who can work independently, take ownership of projects, and navigate ambiguity in dynamic environments
    • Technical proficiency: Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (especially Excel) with comfort learning new claims and provider management software

Why You'll Love It Here

We believe in total rewards that actually matter—not just competitive packages, but benefits that support how you want to live and work.

Your wellbeing and Benefits

  • Your wellbeing comes first: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage through our own health solutions (yes, we use what we build!)
  • Mental health support and wellness programs designed by experts who get it
  • Flexible work arrangements that fit your life, not the other way around
  • Financial security that makes sense: Retirement planning support to help you build real wealth for the future
  • Basic Life and AD&D Insurance plus Short-Term and Long-Term Disability protection
  • Employee savings programs and voluntary benefits like Critical Illness and Hospital Indemnity coverage
  • Growth without limits: Professional development opportunities and clear career progression paths
  • Mentorship from industry leaders who want to see you succeed
  • Learning budget to invest in skills that matter to your future

A culture that energizes

  • People Matter: Inclusive community where every voice matters and diverse perspectives drive innovation
  • One Team One Dream: Collaborative environment where we celebrate wins together and support each other through challenges
  • We Deliver: Mission-driven work that creates real impact on people's health and wellbeing, with clear accountability for results
  • Grow Forward: Continuous learning mindset with team events, recognition programs, and celebrations that make work genuinely enjoyable

The practical stuff

  • Competitive base salary plus bonus structure that rewards your success
  • Unlimited PTO policy because rest and recharge time is non-negotiable
  • Benefits effective day one—because you shouldn’t have to wait to be taken care of

Ready to create a healthier world? We're ready for you.

No candidate will meet every single qualification listed. If your experience looks different but you think you can bring value to this role, we'd love to learn more about you.

Personify Health is an equal opportunity organization and is committed to diversity, inclusion, equity, and social justice.

In compliance with all states and cities that require transparency of pay, the base compensation for this position ranges from $100,000 to $120,000. Note that compensation may vary based on location, skills, and experience. This position is eligible for 10% target bonus/variable compensation as well as health, dental, vision, mental health and other benefits.

We strive to cultivate a work environment where differences are celebrated, and employees of all backgrounds are empowered to thrive. Personify Health is committed to driving Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB) for all stakeholders: employees (at each organization level), members, clients and the communities in which we operate. Diversity is core to who we are and critical to our work in health and wellbeing.

#WeAreHiring #PersonifyHealth

Beware of Hiring Scams: Personify Health will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information such as social security numbers during the hiring process. All official communication will come from a verified company email address. If you receive suspicious requests or communications, please report them All of our legitimate openings can be found on the Personify HealthCareer Site.

title: Senior Security Architect 2
description:
Overview

At Enlyte, we combine innovative technology, clinical expertise, and human compassion to help people recover after workplace injuries or auto accidents. We support their journey back to health and wellness through our industry-leading solutions and services. Whether you're supporting a Fortune 500 client or a local business, developing cutting-edge technology, or providing clinical services you'll work alongside dedicated professionals who share your commitment to excellence and make a meaningful impact. Join us in fueling our mission to protect dreams and restore lives, while building your career in an environment that values collaboration, innovation, and personal growth.

Be part of a team that makes a real difference.

Job Description

This is a remote position and can be located anywhere in the United States.

We are seeking an experienced and strategic Senior Security Architect to join Enlyte's cybersecurity team. This role will be responsible for designing and implementing enterprise-wide security architectures that protect our infrastructure, applications, and data. The ideal candidate will drive security initiatives across cloud and on-premises environments, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and ensure alignment with industry best practices and compliance requirements.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the design and evolution of Enlyte's enterprise security architecture to address emerging threats and compliance requirements.
  • Develop and maintain security policies, standards, and reference architectures for cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) and on-premises environments.
  • Technical experience in designing secure AWS and other public clouds environments and applications including, but not limited to, CSPM, network segmentation, IAM, security monitoring and Threat Prevention and Detection technologies.
  • Provide internal security consulting and design review services for Enlyte product applications, and IT shared services in AWS and other public clouds.
  • Conduct threat modeling, risk assessments, and gap analysis to improve the company\'s overall security posture.
  • Collaborate with senior leadership, engineering teams, and infrastructure groups to integrate security into technology solutions and roadmaps.
  • Provide security architecture expertise for enterprise projects and initiatives.
  • Evaluate emerging security technologies and make recommendations for adoption.
  • Design and implement secure cloud infrastructure with focus on configuration, threat protection, network security, data protection, and identity management.
  • Mentor junior security team members and promote security best practices across the organization.
  • Partner with GRC, SOC, and DevSecOps teams to enforce security controls and automation with a focused shift to preventative control architectures.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor\'s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Engineering, or related field is desirable but can be replaced by equivalent training and experience.
  • 8+ years of experience in cybersecurity roles, with at least 5+ years as a security architect in enterprise environments.
  • Strong experience with cloud security architectures in AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Deep understanding of network security, identity & access management (IAM), data protection, and encryption technologies.
  • Expertise in designing zero trust architectures and implementing security controls across hybrid environments.
  • Experience with security tools such as Palo Alto, CrowdStrike, SIEM, Cloud Native Security, WAF, and similar platforms.
  • Knowledge of security frameworks and standards including NIST, ISO 27001, CIS, and MITRE ATT&CK.
  • Ability to create technical security policies, standards, and best practices.
  • Strong communication and documentation skills with ability to translate complex security concepts to various audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in regulated environments (healthcare, financial services).
  • Knowledge of containerization, microservices architecture, and API security.
  • Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation) and CI/CD pipelines and their security by design.
  • Experience with secure software development lifecycle (SDLC) and DevSecOps principles.
  • Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, AWS Security Specialty, or TOGAF.

Benefits

We’re committed to supporting your ultimate well-being through our total compensation package offerings that support your health, wealth and self. These offerings include Medical, Dental, Vision, Health Savings Accounts / Flexible Spending Accounts, Life and AD&D Insurance, 401(k), Tuition Reimbursement, and an array of resources that encourage a lifetime of healthier living. Benefits eligibility may differ depending on full-time or part-time status. Compensation depends on the applicable US geographic market. The expected base pay for this position ranges from $96,000 - $158,000 annually, and will be based on a number of additional factors including skills, experience, and education.

The Company is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, status as a protected veteran, among other things, or status as a qualified individual with disability.

Tangelo AI is redefining the employee experience through powerful onboarding and internal engagement tools. description:
VEM SER GUARACAMP !

Há 29 anos, nascemos na Zona Oeste do Rio como uma marcaraiz , autêntica como o carioca. Somos oGuaraná Natural mais amado do Rio de Janeiro , e temos orgulho da nossa história de crescimento com os pés no chão, foco no resultado e paixão pelo que fazemos.Aqui,buscamos gente boa para formar um time forte , com atitude de dono, espírito de realização e sede por evolução. Valorizamos quem acredita quetudo pode ser feito melhor , comtransparência, disciplina e vontade de fazer acontecer . Se você se identifica com esses princípios e querdeixar sua marca no mundo , seu lugar é com a gente!

A Guaracamp Disponibiliza vagas para pessoas com Deficiência, conforme Art. 93, Lei 8.213/91 e art. 3º e 4º Dec.3.298-99.

OBJETIVO DO CARGO: O Gerente Geral Comercial será responsável por liderar e gerenciar todos os canais de vendas da empresa, incluindo vendas internas, externas, revendas e parcerias. Seu principal objetivo é otimizar os resultados comerciais, impulsionando as vendas, garantindo a execução das estratégias de mercado, e o alinhamento de todos os times comerciais. O profissional deverá ter uma visão estratégica, orientada para a análise de mercado, desenvolvimento de novos canais e parcerias, e promover a evolução contínua das equipes sob sua gestão.

RESPONSABILIDADES:

• Gestão dos Canais de Vendas: Supervisionar todos os canais de vendas da empresa, garantindo que as metas de vendas sejam alcançadas em cada segmento (interno, externo, revendas, etc.).
• Planejamento Estratégico: Criar e implementar planos de ação para aumentar a performance de vendas em todos os canais, com foco na expansão e otimização dos resultados comerciais.
• Análise de Desempenho Comercial: Monitorar o desempenho de cada canal de vendas, identificando tendências, oportunidades e pontos de melhoria. Utilizar essas informações para ajustar as estratégias de vendas e maximizar a participação de mercado.
• Acompanhamento de Indicadores: Analisar e acompanhar semanalmente os relatórios de vendas, desempenho e KPIs, fazendo ajustes necessários para garantir o atingimento das metas estabelecidas.
• Desenvolvimento de Novas Parcerias: Identificar novas oportunidades de parcerias estratégicas que possam fortalecer a rede de canais de vendas e ampliar a capilaridade do mercado.
• Pesquisa de Mercado: Realizar pesquisas contínuas sobre o mercado, concorrência e tendências, com o objetivo de fornecer insights e propostas de ação para a área comercial.
• Treinamento e Desenvolvimento: Planejar e coordenar treinamentos para gerentes de vendas, supervisores e equipes comerciais, visando aprimorar as competências técnicas e comportamentais.
• Gestão de Relacionamentos: Desenvolver e manter relacionamentos sólidos com parceiros comerciais, clientes-chave e outros stakeholders, promovendo o crescimento e a fidelização.
• Suporte a Gerentes e Supervisores: Oferecer suporte contínuo aos gerentes de unidades e supervisores, fornecendo orientações, ferramentas e recursos necessários para o atingimento das metas comerciais.
• Coordenação de Projetos Comerciais: Gerenciar projetos comerciais estratégicos, desde a concepção até a execução, garantindo a implementação eficaz e os resultados esperados.
• Ajustes e Melhoria Contínua: Identificar e implementar melhorias nos processos comerciais, utilizando feedbacks de equipe, clientes e mercado para refinar as práticas de vendas e aumentar a produtividade.
• Gestão do Orçamento Comercial: Controlar e gerenciar os custos comerciais, garantindo que as ações sejam realizadas dentro do orçamento previsto e que haja uma boa alocação de recursos.
• Análise de Concorrência: Acompanhar de perto as estratégias de concorrentes e realizar ajustes nas estratégias internas para manter ou aumentar a competitividade da empresa.

REQUISITOS:

1. Ensino Superior Completo. Desejável Pós Graduação ou MBA na área
2. Atuação anterior em gestão na área comercial com entendimento de todos os canais (direto e indireto)
3. Pacote Office avançado
4. CNH tipo B

HABILIDADES:

1. Visão de Mercado
2. Liderança
3. Resiliência e Adaptabilidade
4. Orientação para Resultados

title: Senior Devops Engineer
description:

Job Mode : Full-time

Overview

As a Senior DevOps Engineer, you will actively interface with software developers, product managers, test engineers, and administrators on projects to design and develop the build, release, and deploy toolchain for DevOps while providing on-call support. You should be able to identify, troubleshoot and resolve issues quickly and effectively, sometimes under pressure. Responsibilities include capacity planning, high availability engineering, performance tuning, and automation / tools development. You should have good leadership skills, experience managing infrastructure through multiple product releases, and have a passion for reliability and security.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Lead the design and management of highly available, scalable Kubernetes infrastructure using Amazon EKS;
  • Implement and manage infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) with Terraform and Terragrunt;
  • Champion a Git-first approach to infrastructure and CI / CD automation;
  • Build and maintain robust CI / CD pipelines using Harness to streamline application delivery across environments;
  • Drive infrastructure automation and environment consistency across development, staging, and production;
  • Design and implement monitoring and observability solutions using New Relic, ensuring performance visibility and uptime;
  • Securely manage secrets using AWS Secrets Manager;
  • Support production systems through incident management, root cause analysis, and proactive reliability improvements;
  • Collaborate with engineering and security teams to define best practices for deployment, security, and scalability;
  • Mentor and guide junior DevOps team members and developers in adopting modern infrastructure practices.

Essential Skills

  • Experience with DevOps, SRE, or Platform Engineering role supporting cloud-native applications;
  • Extensive experience with Kubernetes (EKS), including Helm, networking, and security;
  • Deep proficiency in Terraform and Terragrunt for AWS infrastructure provisioning;
  • Proven expertise building pipelines with Harness, Git, and associated CI / CD tooling;
  • Strong scripting and automation skills using Python or Golang;
  • Solid understanding of AWS services : EKS, EC2, S3, IAM, RDS, VPC, Route53, CloudWatch, etc;
  • Proficient with Linux systems, including performance tuning and troubleshooting;
  • Deep knowledge of networking fundamentals : DNS, TLS, HTTP / S, Load Balancing;
  • Experience with Ansible for configuration and provisioning;
  • Working knowledge of MySQL and PostgreSQL;
  • Strong experience in monitoring, logging, and alerting, particularly using New Relic;
  • Experience with Kafka, RabbitMQ, or other pub / sub systems is a plus;
  • Demonstrated ability to support and troubleshoot distributed products.

About Encora

Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.

At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Platform Operations Engineer
description:
Overview

Zartis is a digital solutions provider working across technology strategy, software engineering and product development.

We partner with firms across financial services, MedTech, media, logistics technology, renewable energy, EdTech, e-commerce, and more. Our engineering hubs in EMEA and LATAM are full of talented professionals delivering business success and digital improvement across application development, software architecture, CI / CD, business intelligence, QA automation, and new technology integrations.

The project

We are looking for a Platform Operations Engineer to work on a project in the data analytics sector.

The project :

Our teammates are talented people that come from a variety of backgrounds. We’re committed to building an inclusive culture based on trust and innovation.

We are seeking an energetic engineer with strong platform operations experience in AWS to join our client’s team in developing and scaling their data socialization and visualization platform, Atlas. This is a hands-on individual contributor (IC) role where you will lead by example through design, coding, and problem-solving. You will collaborate closely with their existing Backend Engineering Team Lead while holding primary accountability for platform operations. You will report directly to the CTO and work alongside the engineering and product teams to ensure reliability, scalability, and performance. While everyone contributes across boundaries on their small team, this role is intended to take leadership accountability for platform operations while also assisting with backend development

What you will do

  • Lead the design, operation, and improvement of AWS platform infrastructure to ensure robustness, security, and scalability.
  • Manage and optimize CI / CD pipelines, observability, cost monitoring, and system reliability.
  • Collaborate with backend engineers to develop and maintain APIs and backend services for the Atlas platform.
  • Write comprehensive unit and integration tests, adhering to best practices.
  • Participate in code reviews and peer programming.
  • Produce technical requirements documents and system designs for platform enhancements.
  • Collaborate with Frontend, Data Engineering, and Product teams to align platform and backend development with business needs.
  • Break down operational initiatives into actionable projects and lead their execution.
  • Mentor junior engineers and guide best practices in platform operations.
  • Provide on-call support rotation for platform stability.
  • Report directly to the CTO, providing updates on platform health, risks, and opportunities.

What you will bring

  • 3+ years of backend engineering experience (REST / GraphQL APIs, Python, or similar).
  • 2+ years of professional experience in platform operations, cloud infrastructure, or DevOps.
  • Real-world experience with SQL and cloud-based data systems.
  • Proficiency in AWS services (ECS, EKS, RDS, Lambda, Secrets Manager, etc.).
  • Infrastructure as Code expertise, with CloudFormation (primary) and Terraform (secondary).
  • Experience with container orchestration and infrastructure automation (Git, CI / CD, Docker).
  • Familiarity with observability stacks (CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana, or similar).
  • Strong leadership in technical strategy, platform design, and reliability.
  • Proven ability to work independently and collaboratively in a distributed team.
  • A. / B.S. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, related area, or relevant experience.

Nice to have

  • Experience with Snowflake, Databricks, Athena, or GraphQL.

What we offer

  • 100% Remote Work
  • WFH allowance : Monthly payment as financial support for remote working.
  • Career Growth : We have established a career development program accessible for all employees with a 360º feedback that will help us to guide you in your career progression.
  • Training : For Tech training at Zartis, you have time allocated during the week at your disposal. You can request from a variety of options, such as online courses (from Pluralsight and Educative.io, for example), English classes, books, conferences, and events.
  • Mentoring Program : You can become a mentor in Zartis or you can receive mentorship, or both.
  • Zartis Wellbeing Hub (Kara Connect) : A platform that provides sessions with a range of specialists, including mental health professionals, nutritionists, physiotherapists, fitness coaches, and webinars with such professionals as well.
  • Multicultural working environment : We organize tech events, webinars, parties, and activities to do online team-building games and contests.

Atuar como referência técnica e consultiva para os assuntos contábeis relacionados às exigências da Agência Nacional de Saúde Suplementar (ANS). Conhecimentos específicos

Overview

We are looking for a Business Intelligence Analyst to join our team. This professional will be responsible for taking raw information – numbers or qualitative data sets – and constructing narratives that help our business colleagues to make better decisions. The primary goal of this position is to take large volumes of complex data, extract insights, and help solve problems.

Responsibilities

  • Work with stakeholders to understand reporting needs, identifying and querying data sources to get the required data.
  • Cleanse and massage data into the shape required, creating Tableau datasets, reports, and dashboards to meet requirements.
  • Present and gather feedback from stakeholders on the finished product.
  • Deploy data, reports, and dashboards to Tableau; develop reports according to analyst-defined specifications.
  • Conduct technical training.
  • Maintain and document the operational environment.
  • Maintain and process SQL Server SPs and queries.

Requirements

  • At least 3 years of experience developing Business Intelligence dashboards and reports, analyzing, and visualizing data.
  • An understanding of Tableau administration, licensing, security, and deployment, and at least 1 year of previous work experience using Tableau.
  • A solid understanding of the concepts involved in modeling relational data.
  • Strong analytic skills, with a hands-on approach with the ability to deliver commitments.
  • Superior organizational skills, with a disciplined approach to implementation, support, and documentation.
  • Experience with ETL of data from a variety of sources using SSIS, Python, or similar technologies (is a plus).
  • Knowledge of SQL Server database architecture (components and processes of the database) and/or experience with creating tabular data models in SQL Server (is a plus).
  • Advanced English level.
  • Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.
  • Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.
  • Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.
At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.
Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture
Join Howard University and thrive with us!
 Purpose
The successful candidate will play a critical role in the design, synthesis, and characterization of novel nanomaterials for drug delivery applications, as well as the development of advanced chemical biology tools. This individual will be responsible for applying expertise in nanoparticle production, fluorescent labeling strategies for biomolecules, and robust bioconjugate synthesis to advance our pipeline of innovative therapeutics and diagnostics.
Supervisory Authority
This position may involve supervising undergraduate and graduate students.
Nature And Scope
Internal contacts include Jacqueline Smith. External contacts include N/A.
Principal Accountabilities
The Research Scientist will be responsible for the following.
  • Design, synthesize, and characterize various types of nanoparticles (e.g., liposomes, polymeric nanoparticles, inorganic nanoparticles) for targeted drug delivery, gene therapy, or diagnostic imaging applications.
  • Optimize nanoparticle formulation parameters (size, morphology, surface charge, drug loading, release kinetics) for desired in vitro and in vivo performance.
  • Develop and implement robust analytical methods for nanoparticle characterization (e.g., DLS, TEM, SEM, HPLC, UV-Vis, fluorescence spectroscopy).
  • Evaluate the stability, biocompatibility, and efficacy of nanoparticle-based systems.
  • Develop and optimize strategies for site-specific and quantitative fluorescent labeling of peptides, proteins, antibodies, and other biomolecules.
  • Work with a variety of fluorescent dyes and fluorophores, including organic dyes, quantum dots, and fluorescent proteins.
  • Characterize labeled biomolecules for purity, integrity, and functionality using techniques such as gel electrophoresis, mass spectrometry, and fluorescence spectroscopy.
  • Design and execute synthetic routes for the efficient and reproducible conjugation of various molecules (e.g., drugs, targeting ligands, imaging agents) to nanoparticles, peptides, proteins, and other biomolecules.
  • Utilize a range of bioconjugation chemistries (e.g., click chemistry, amide coupling, maleimide chemistry, hydrazone formation) to achieve desired conjugation outcomes.
  • Purify and characterize bioconjugates using appropriate chromatographic and spectroscopic methods.
  • Design and synthesize novel small molecules, linkers, and probes for various biological applications.
  • Presenting research findings at regular group meetings, as well as local and national conferences
  • Publishing findings in peer-reviewed journals
Core Competencies
  • Extensive hands-on experience with the synthesis, characterization, and application of various nanoparticle systems for drug delivery (e.g., liposomes, polymeric nanoparticles, micelles, dendrimers).
  • Proficiency in a wide range of analytical techniques for nanoparticle characterization (e.g., DLS, TEM, SEM, cryo-TEM, HPLC, FPLC, UV-Vis, fluorescence spectroscopy, zeta potential).
  • Demonstrated expertise in diverse bioconjugation chemistries (e.g., EDC/NHS, maleimide-thiol, click chemistry, hydrazone, oxime ligations).
  • Proven ability to design and execute strategies for fluorescent labeling of peptides, proteins, and other biomolecules.
  • Strong background in organic synthesis and purification techniques (e.g., column chromatography, HPLC, LC-MS).
  • Solid understanding of biomolecular interactions and protein chemistry.
  • Proficiency in data analysis software and scientific literature databases.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative team in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and a commitment to scientific rigor.
Minimum Requirements
M.S. in Chemical Biology or Biochemistry and 1-2 years of experience or Ph.D. Chemical Biology or Biochemistry

As a Software Engineer at BWZ you are responsible for the whole development process, starting with discovering, planning and developing, ending with testing and deploying. You will work in an environment that offers freedom with responsibility, and encourages simplicity with risk taking.

You will be working in BWZ's Tech Team, highly involved in the development of our back-end systems and integrations (using Node.js, Python, AWS, etc), but also participating in the development and architecture of our multi-site Web Platform (built in WordPress), our Ad Tech Platform (built in Ruby on Rails), among many other systems and products.

Reporting to the Technology Director, working in the BWZ Labs Team but also closely with the Web Platform. You will be tasked with the development of internal systems used by dozens of employees, as well as customer-facing systems used by thousands of clients.

  • An unbridled openness to learning new technology
  • Great time-management and prioritization skills

Black and White Zebra is a rapidly growing, independent media tech company headquartered in Vancouver, B.C. Canada. Since 2012, our portfolio of influential digital publications has been helping millions of people succeed at work. Overview

Closing Date: September 25, 2025, 11:59 PM Brasilia Standard Time

Primary Location: Rio De Janeiro, Brazil

Organization: AFT Centro Panamericano de Fiebre Aftosa (PANAFTOSA)

Schedule: Full time

Description of Duties / Organizational Context

The incumbent is responsible for the management of the Pan American Foot-and-Mouth Disease Center and Veterinary Public Health (PANAFTOSA), providing leadership on the principles and implementation of PAHO’s technical cooperation on Veterinary Public Health and One Health. The incumbent promotes the applications of One Health good practices and is responsible for the management and administration of the Center’s human and financial resources and fixed assets. He/she must maintain a harmonious and effective collaboration with counterparts in national and international administrations, and non-government, philanthropic, academic and private organizations, from the public health, agriculture and animal health sectors. The incumbent should cultivate and maintain a close professional relationship with Brazilian Authorities, particularly those related to the operation and maintenance of the Center, in accordance with the Agreement signed by the Government of Brazil with PAHO for the Center. The incumbent follows broadly stated guidance in terms of policy and mission of the Organization and has the authority to establish guidelines of major importance on programmatic activities and Center’s management and administration operations to address problems that might require complex considerations and alternative possible solutions, involving internal and external stakeholders. The incumbent acts as prime advisor of the Organization to discuss problems and seek solutions on VPH and One Health policy issues in direct coordination with the Assistant Director in the area of One Health. The incumbent will be responsible for the VPH and One Health component of the PAHO Strategic Plan and Biennial Work Plans, within the framework of the policy orientations and mandates of the Governing Bodies.

Summary of Responsibilities

Under the direct supervision of the Director, Communicable Diseases and Environmental Determinants of Health (CDE) and the general supervision of the Assistant Director (AD), the incumbent is responsible for the following duties:

  • Lead the Organization’s technical cooperation on Veterinary Public Health (VPH) for the elimination of Foot-and-Mouth Disease (FMD), food safety and antimicrobial resistance (AMR) in the food of animal origin value chain, and the prevention, control/elimination of zoonotic and foodborne diseases and envenomation in the Americas, consistent with the One Health approach.
  • Direct, manage, plan, organize, implement and evaluate programs necessary to achieve the aims and objectives of the Center’s technical cooperation, including field interventions, research, training and dissemination of information.
  • Provide technical expertise and lead the normative function of the Organization regarding food safety and control/elimination of FMD and zoonotic diseases in collaboration with partners, academia, ministries of health, ministries of agriculture, and other stakeholders.
  • Advise and promote inter-programmatic work across the Organization to ensure efficient use of resources and alignment with biennium work plans and strategic priorities.
  • Lead and direct the management and administration of the Center, ensuring alignment with the Strategic Plan, Biennial Work Plans, UNDSS security requirements, and business continuity planning.
  • Direct and guide technical cooperation for strengthening national and international disease information and surveillance systems on FMD, and foodborne and zoonotic diseases.
  • Direct technical cooperation for strengthening national laboratories and international laboratory networks, including training programs and coordinating reference services.
  • Oversee the Organization’s WOAH Reference Laboratory on FMD and WOAH Collaborating Center on Veterinary Public Health.
  • Mobilize human and financial resources in support of national programs and cooperate with member states in designing and evaluating project proposals.
  • Serve as the Secretary of COSALFA and REDIPRA, including planning and managing meetings and presenting at international events.
  • Provide leadership to staff in a multicultural environment, mentor supervised staff, set objectives, conduct performance reviews, and promote staff development.
  • Promote ethical behavior and integrity in line with PAHO’s Code of Ethical Principles and Conduct.
  • Provide a stable managerial framework and advise Member States’ institutions in the area of expertise.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.

Key Behavioral Competencies

Overall attitude at work: Maintains integrity, ethical approach, and accountability; respects colleagues and counterparts.

Respecting and valuing individual differences: Treats everyone with dignity and respect; avoids stereotypes; considers others’ perspectives.

Teamwork: Fosters collaboration across the Organization, builds partnerships, and maintains an effective network.

Communication: Articulates strategic objectives, adapts to audiences, and shares knowledge and directives effectively.

Creating an empowering and motivating environment: Provides direction, motivates teams, and promotes autonomy and high performance.

Ensuring effective use of resources: Sets measurable objectives, allocates resources, and monitors progress.

Driving the Organization to a successful future: Leads with vision, fosters a culture of long-term goals, and rewards progress.

Technical Expertise

  • Technical: Extensive senior experience in managing complex human/animal health programs at national and international levels; strong knowledge of public and animal health, veterinary public health, surveillance, and evidence-based advisory capabilities.
  • Managerial: Senior management experience in large administrations; proficiency in health administration, international legislation, negotiation, and organizational development.
  • Administrative: Resource mobilization, financial management, and administration platforms for Finance, Budget, HR, and Infrastructure; ability to handle confidential information.

Education (Qualifications)

Essential: University degree in veterinary medical science, and a master’s degree in public health, veterinary public health, animal health, veterinary epidemiology, or related field from an accredited institution.

Desirable: Doctoral degree in a public health or animal health-related area.

Experience

Essential: Thirteen years of progressively increased responsibilities in national and international management, with experience designing, planning, executing, and evaluating technical cooperation related to public and animal health; involvement in international technical cooperation programs and activities in veterinary public health and One Health; experience with FMD, food safety, zoonoses, and epidemiological surveillance at the international level.

Languages

Very good knowledge of English and Spanish with a working knowledge of another language. Knowledge of Portuguese and/or French would be an asset.

IT Skills

Demonstrated ability to use current technology and software, ERP and management information systems; proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Outlook, OneDrive, PowerPoint, Teams, Visio, SharePoint and Project is an asset.
